title: QUIC RFC 9000 Connection ID Retry Sequencing and Migration Pool Tail Verification
verification_method: Focused S5P1P1 requirement-home tests over non-sequenced first client-selected and Retry-provided CIDs plus migrated-path local CID pool replenishment, followed by Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the remaining generated non-clean S5P1P1 tail after the sequence and active-set floor closure.
expected_result: The focused tests show that a first client-selected Destination CID and a Retry Source CID do not consume peer CID sequence numbers, the observed peer Initial Source CID remains the implicit sequence-0 input, a Retry Source CID can later be explicitly issued through preferred_address sequence 1 including the maximum-length boundary, and migrated-path use of a previously unused locally issued CID replenishes the peer-usable CID pool only when the peer active limit and local issuance budget allow it.
procedure: Run the focused S5P1P1 tail requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The S5P1P1 connection-ID sequence and active-set floor remains closed under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0074.
Retry replay processing remains closed under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0060.
Transport-parameter connection-ID binding remains closed under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0059.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim public local migration APIs, multipath, Retry integrity validation changes, public API widening, or hosted interop readiness.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the focused S5P1P1 tail filter passed 7/7, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P1P1-0007 and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P1P1-0019 trace_clean and reports 1,296 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 469 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,542/4,542, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
